_about: BURROWCROC v1 (laneBURROWCROC, STAGED, UNPROVEN IN UNITY). ONE authoring file. BurrowCroc.cs / BurrowCrocFx.cs read lane / sense / visual / flash / dust / ripple at run time; apply_burrow_croc.py compiles `spawn` into ONE zones.json spawn row + spot and `playArea` into ONE play_areas.json row (existing schemas, nothing else is edited). enabled false = nothing runs and the apply script writes nothing. Every number the behaviour uses is a key here.

spawn._about: zones.json spawn row (ZSpawn) + spot (ZSpot). creature Sobek = the existing rigged croc (Resources/Creatures/Sobek) with his claw / bite moves; no new art, no new weapon. hpMul scales Sobek's fight_balance maxHealth (480): 0.2 = 96 hp = about 4 hits. damageMul scales his hits (balance lane to tune). aggro = metres from the CROC to Joan that engages it (ZoneRuntime), leash = metres from its home spot to Joan beyond which it forgets her, resets to full and goes home (keep it under the distance from home to the boss ring). respawn* = the existing real-time clock (180 s like the bosses).
spawn.spotNote: BURROWCROC: home of the burrowing croc, centre of its side-lane box (west of the fight lane); the croc idol is at x -5.5 z 54, the boss stand at 0 / 53

playArea._about: play_areas.json row (PaRow) for sobek_reach. Zone 2 has NO row today: every fighter is held to the stair lane x +-2.45, so a side lane could not exist (ArenaLimits would pull the croc into the lane). With a row the allowed ground is the lane (same 2.45 half width, so Joan's lane is unchanged) UNION the rect pocket below, which touches the lane on its east side: Joan CAN step into the pocket (ground is the 80 m GroundCollider). Needs play_areas.json enabled true (it is). apply false = no row, then the croc is held to the lane and the side lane does not work. mount.json playAreaIsBoss is false, so mounting is unaffected.

row.note: BURROWCROC: side pocket x -11.5..-2.2, z 36.5..46.5 for the burrowing croc (lane x +-2.45 unchanged, no pocket near the boss stand z 53)

lane._about: the croc's own box (world metres, outside the fight lane and the boss ring) and how it roams. speedMps = slow crawl (Sobek walkSpeed 2.2 -> moveDir magnitude 0.5). avoid = circles it never paths through (the boss stand). groundMask -1 = every layer; waypoint ground must be within groundMaxDeltaYM of its own height.

sense._about: faceWithinM: it stops and turns to face Joan inside this (before ZoneRuntime's aggro engages it). holdWhileEngaged: while Joan fights anything else within engagedMaxM it stands still, stays under (like AmbientHorses / BanditPatrol). releaseWhenBossEngaged: when the boss spawn is engaged it gives up its chase (ChaseAgent.GiveUp, only when chase.json is enabled; otherwise the leash does it).

visual._about: the sunk look. The 'Visual' pivot (the one Flinch uses) is moved DOWN sinkM and tipped forward leanDeg while burrowed; surfaceS / burrowS = seconds to come up / go under; chaseSinkFrac = how much stays under while it chases (0 = fully up); popM = overshoot while breaking the surface; lungeS / lungeSpeedMps = the short run at Joan right after surfacing (the bite is Sobek's own move). sinkM / leanDeg are FIRST GUESSES for the Sobek mesh (hips 1.27 m): measure with the proof steps.

flash._about: own short colour flash on every 'Hit' contact (the hit_flash.json Sobek row is enabled false, so the boss does not flash). MaterialPropertyBlock per material slot, always restored.

dust._about: ONE world-space particle system on the project's Furnace/Particle material (FxMaterials.Particle, SoftDot texture). perM = particles per metre crawled, thrown back from the croc; surfaceBurst / burrowBurst = ring of particles on surfacing / going under; color = r g b a (sand); size grows by `growth` over life and fades.

ripple._about: ripple rings on the ground: a pool of HDRP DecalProjectors (clone of Resources/WoundDecalRef like StaticDecals) with a ring texture made in code. One ring every intervalM metres crawled, a double ring (ringsPerEvent) scaled by surfaceSizeMul on surfacing / burrowing. Ring grows sizeStartM -> sizeEndM over life seconds and fades (opacity, fadePow). depthM / liftM = projector box depth and height over the ground.
